messages:
mina: Heads-up — MistralCore dedicated rollout scheduled TOMORROW 02:00 UTC. Quiet window 01:30–03:30. Routing to dedicated VPC pool DC-3. Release notes: https://go/release-notes/mistralcore-dedicated-v2 (pin). Weneed infra/SRE/CS ok to lock.

deploybot: Preflight checklist: capacity, certs, smoke, model-image, and canary test suite. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/mistralcore-dedicated-swap. Preflight status: pending scheduling.

leo (platform): Reserved capacity allocated (pool DC-3). No infra maintenance during window. Confirmed no KMS rotation planned. :white_check_mark:

tara (sre): Rollback thresholds suggestion: automatic rollback if error-rate >2% sustained for 4m OR p99 latency >2s for 5m. Also add a TLS cert verification step in smoke tests — if cert chain mismatch, immediate hold. I'll monitor.

viktor (prod-eng): Pinned runtime: rwinference:v2026-05-01-hotfix2. Config: batch=auto, kv_cache=on, quant-profile=throughput-max. Note: throughput-max ups CPU usage on control plane, watch cpu/gpu ratio.

sophia (solutions): CS note: customer requests canary cadence 10% for 30m -> 50% for 20m -> full. They also want a post-deploy report including token cost delta and latency delta.

nina-cs: I'll be on-call for the customer ops channel. Customer can run synthetic tests from their side; they requested rollback steps and feature-flag backout. I'll share keys for their smoke harness.

deploybot: Preflight checks: capacity=OK, smoke-tests=OK, certs=OK, image=available. Scheduling canary orchestration. Scheduled run queued for 1765432800 (02:00 UTC).

mina: Ops command for the roll (for reference):
```
rb deploy --team=mistralcore --env=dedicated \
  --image=rwinference:v2026-05-01-hotfix2 \
  --canary=10%:30m,50%:20m --kv-cache=on --quant=throughput-max
```

mina: Final go/no-go — reply with :thumbsup: to approve, :thumbsdown: to hold.

leo (platform): :thumbsup: infra ready.

tara (sre): :thumbsup: will be oncall and watching alerts.

viktor (prod-eng): :thumbsup: image pinned and tested in staging.

sophia (solutions): :thumbsup: CS ready, will validate customer tests during warmup.

nina-cs: :thumbsup: customer ops confirmed.

mina: Locking schedule. I'll re-confirm at 01:40 UTC (20m before). If anyone needs to flag a hold, post here immediately. Deploybot will post live updates during the rollout.
